sql:
SELECT
    StoreKey,
    StoreName,
    actual_sales,
    sales_quota,
    round(actual_sales / nullIf(sales_quota, 0) * 100, 2) AS attainment_pct,
    rank_pos
FROM (
    SELECT
        s.StoreKey,
        st.StoreName,
        actual_sales,
        sales_quota,
        row_number() OVER (ORDER BY actual_sales / nullIf(sales_quota, 0) DESC) AS rn_top,
        row_number() OVER (ORDER BY actual_sales / nullIf(sales_quota, 0) ASC)  AS rn_bottom,
        count(*) OVER ()                                                          AS total,
        'top'                                                                     AS rank_pos
    FROM (
        SELECT StoreKey, sum(SalesAmount) AS actual_sales
        FROM retail.FactSales
        WHERE toYear(DateKey) = 2009
        GROUP BY StoreKey
    ) s
    JOIN (
        SELECT StoreKey, sum(SalesAmountQuota) AS sales_quota
        FROM retail.FactSalesQuota
        WHERE toYear(DateKey) = 2009
        GROUP BY StoreKey
    ) q ON s.StoreKey = q.StoreKey
    JOIN retail.DimStore st ON s.StoreKey = st.StoreKey
) t
WHERE rn_top <= 5 OR rn_bottom <= 5
ORDER BY attainment_pct DESC
